name: A. R. Fausset
bio:
Irish-born Anglican clergyman, for many years rector of St Cuthbert's, York, and a canon of York Minster.

With Robert Jamieson and David Brown he wrote the Commentary Critical and Explanatory on the Whole Bible (1871), taking the books from Job to Malachi himself; he also revised the English translation of Bengel's Gnomon.
